description: This shell script is a test suite for a Git and Perforce integration, specifically testing the git-p4 command and related functions like cloning, syncing, and managing Perforce groups. It creates repositories, sets up depots, adds files, and performs various fetch and clone operations to ensure correct behavior.

methods.name: create_restricted_group
methods.description: Creates a Perforce group named 'restricted' with limited max results and scan rows, and assigns the 'author' user.

methods.name: p4_add_file
methods.description: Adds a new file to Perforce in the current directory and submits it with a specified filename.
